classification.definition: Stored pipeline level 2: Gold membership, also included in Silver.

residue_series.definition: Largest symbol frequency times the producer r_i sequence-logo information parameter at the position, rounded to three decimals. No probability interpretation is asserted.
Producer h_i = -sum(f * ln(f)), where f is symbol count divided by the maximum aligned-entry count across positions. Frequencies need not sum to one in a partially occupied column.

Producer r_i = log2(20) - h_i + 19/(2*max_rows*ln(2)), where h_i uses natural logarithms. Retained as a producer parameter; mixed logarithm bases preclude labeling this value as Shannon information in bits.
Number of aligned entries at this position divided by the maximum aligned-entry count across positions in the producer alignment.

Mean DSSP relative solvent accessibility over a centered 25-residue window with reflected padding at sequence ends (producer disorder-25), rounded to three decimals. Higher values indicate greater accessibility used by AlphaFold-disorder to predict disorder. This is not 1 minus pLDDT or a calibrated disorder probability. Stored regions are retained separately.

Number of contributing disorder predictors voting positive divided by the number of contributing predictors at this residue. This is agreement, not a calibrated probability. Regions additionally apply the producer postprocessing.

measurements.definition: nu predicted by the MobiDB-lite support-vector-regression model from sequence properties for this region, rounded to three decimals. A scaling exponent, not an evidence confidence score.

residue_series.definition: AlphaFold-disorder binding-25-0.581 composite: let a be the centered 25-residue mean DSSP relative solvent accessibility with reflected end padding and p be pLDDT divided by 100. The score is a when a <= 0.581, otherwise 0.581 + (1 - 0.581) * p, rounded to three decimals. Higher scores identify accessible residues with local structural confidence as candidate linear interacting peptides. This is not a calibrated binding probability. Stored regions are retained separately.

AlphaFold per-residue pLDDT divided by 100, retained at the producer precision of three decimals. Higher values indicate higher local structural confidence. This stored scale is 0–1, not the conventional 0–100 pLDDT scale; it is not a disorder or binding probability.

annotation_sets.definition: Named UniProt REGION annotations other than disorder; the legacy processing key does not imply proteolytic processing. Original evidence was not retained.
UniProt MOD_RES annotations. Original evidence was not retained by the producer.

regions.label: Phosphoserine; by GRK2, PLK2, CK2, CK1 and GRK5
